items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Clyde was playing the piano, Buster Bailey playing clarinet, Charlie Shavers was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: And on the bandstand, was Clyde Hart. He was a pretty good piano player. He always ran around with Art Tatum and smoked a cigar. He was good for chord structure. He played somewhat on the style of Teddy Wilson. He was out here with Stuff Smith's band also. Same time that Cozy Cole was with the band. I think that band, speaking of Stuff's band. He had

Bernard Addison playing guitar. Jonah Jones, Cozy, I can't remember the bass player's name and Clyde Heart. But anyway, at the Vanguard, Clyde was playing the piano, Buster Bailey playing clarinet, Charlie Shavers was playing trumpet. Ben Tharp, Ben, Ed Thigpen's father, playing drums and myself. Now they all stayed on the bandstand. Lester looked up and said whispering grass, (laughter), didn't any of them move off the bandstand. They no fighters, no heart for fighting. Clyde Heart's got his fingers and things…

So I go to court and they read the charges and everything. Now I can't tell why we were fighting, otherwise I'm going to blow it on Sid and Ben and all three of us will get kicked out of the union. I can't open my mouth.
